map.码率越高画质一定越好吗？: Does a higher bitrate always mean better quality?
map.通常码率越高细节保留越多、文件越大，但受编码器效率与画面复杂度影响；过高码率收益: Generally a higher bitrate preserves more detail and makes a larger file, but it depends on encoder efficiency and scene complexity; beyond a point the returns diminish.
